title: Unisex Pickleball – My Partner Says It Was Out Tee
hook: Two doubles partners stand at the line: one points down hard at a ball sitting exactly on the paint, the other crosses her arms and looks away. This is a pickleball gift for the couple, the doubles team or the club that has had this exact argument at every open play.
art: The print is a 1950s sports-program scene: a man in a mustard sweater and headband jabbing a finger at a pickleball on the white line, a woman in a striped top and cap with her arms crossed, wooden paddles in both their hands, on a worn strip of red court. MY PARTNER SAYS runs across the top and IT WAS OUT. across the bottom in heavy slab capitals.
wear: Wear it to open play, a doubles tournament or the car ride home, or hand it to the couple who play together and still argue about the line call.
qa: What is the My Partner Says It Was Out tee?

It is a unisex graphic tee from Graphic Tees Co. showing two 1950s doubles partners arguing a line call, lettered MY PARTNER SAYS IT WAS OUT. It is printed on a Bella+Canvas 3001 in 4.2 oz cotton, so it stays light and cool on the court.
How does the unisex tee fit?

This Graphic Tees Co. tee is a true unisex cut in sizes S through 4XL with a crew neck and side-seamed body. Order your usual size for a classic fit or size up one for a looser look. If the size is off, the first exchange is free.
What is it made of and how do I wash it?

The tee is 100% combed, ring-spun cotton, with heather colors blending in some polyester, at a lightweight 4.2 oz. Wash it inside out in cold water with like colors and tumble dry low. That keeps the red, mustard and navy inks crisp wash after wash.
Is it a good pickleball gift for a couple?

Yes. It suits partners who play doubles together, club friends and the teammate who always swears the ball was in. It comes from Graphic Tees Co. at $24.99 in eight colors, sizes S through 4XL, and the free size exchange makes it safe to give as a birthday or club gift.
Can I get it by Christmas?

Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. pickleball tee should arrive before Christmas. Each shirt is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess.
